# Freshsales Pricing (November 2026): Growth, Pro, Enterprise, and No Free Plan

Freshsales costs $9, $39 or $59 per user per month billed annually ($11, $47, $71 monthly). The free plan for 3 users is no longer on the pricing page; there is a 21-day trial. Checked November 11, 2026.

 Nov 11, 2026

Freshsales is the sales CRM from Freshworks. Its prices have not changed this year, but its free plan has disappeared from the pricing page, and most AI assistants have not noticed. Every price below was read on Freshworks' Freshsales pricing page on November 11, 2026, in US dollars.

> Quick Answer: Freshsales costs $9 (Growth), $39 (Pro) or $59 (Enterprise) per user per month billed annually, or $11, $47 and $71 billed monthly. The pricing page no longer shows a free plan: new users get a 21-day trial, and Freshworks says the account is suspended if no plan is chosen at the end. Add-ons: branded documents $19 per user per month, and the Freddy AI Agent $49 per 100 sessions.

## Plans and prices

| Plan | Billed annually (per user per month) | Billed monthly (per user per month) | For |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Growth | $9 | $11 | Startups and SMBs: Kanban view, lifecycle stages, chat, email and phone, basic workflows |
| Pro | $39 | $47 | Adds contact scoring, deal insights, territory management, sales sequences |
| Enterprise | $59 | $71 | Adds forecasting insights, field-level permissions, custom modules, sandbox, audit logs |

Freshworks advertises "Save 20%" for annual billing.

## What happened to the free plan

The pricing page we read on November 11, 2026 lists only the three paid plans and a 21-day trial. Snapshots of the same page kept by UsagePricing show the $0 plan for up to 3 users on July 14, 2026 and gone on July 21, 2026. One leftover: the page's own search description still says "with a free plan", which may be where some of the confusion comes from.

...

## What the seat price does not cover

- Branded documents (quotes and proposals): $19 per user per month on every plan.
- Freddy AI Agent: $49 per 100 sessions. Freshworks counts all of one person's chats with the bot in a day as one session.
- Payment: the FAQ says US-dollar payment by cheque is only for US and Canadian customers.

...

In our weekly CRM measurement on November 9, 2026, Freshsales was named in 27 of 84 answers. The Growth price most of them quote, $9 per user billed annually, is right. The free plan is not:

- ChatGPT (with web search) listed Freshsales as "Free for up to 3 users" and recommended "Freshsales' free plan or Growth plan".
- Perplexity said "its free plan covers up to three users".
- Claude (with web search) called it "the alternative if calling matters, since it offers a Free plan for up to 3 users".
- Gemini and Claude, answering from memory, also described a free tier.

Freshworks' pricing page has not shown that plan since July 2026. A buyer following these answers will sign up expecting a free account and get a 21-day trial.

## How we checked

- Source: Freshworks' Freshsales pricing page, read November 11, 2026 with both the annual and the monthly toggle.
- The free-plan removal date comes from a third party's dated snapshots, not from Freshworks; we confirmed only that the plan is absent today.
- AI answers: Markaicode AI Recommendation Index, CRM category, run of November 9, 2026 (84 answers). Method.

...

### Does Freshsales still have a free plan?

Not on its pricing page. On November 11, 2026 the page listed Growth, Pro and Enterprise and a 21-day trial. Third-party snapshots show the free plan for 3 users was removed in July 2026.

### How much is Freshsales per user?

Growth is $9 per user per month billed annually or $11 billed monthly. Pro is $39 or $47, and Enterprise $59 or $71.

text:

Consider alternatives when: 1. A very large integration marketplace is required - If the technology stack depends on many niche or specialized apps, alternatives with broader native integrations (for example, HubSpot or Salesforce combined with an integration partner ecosystem) may reduce custom development effort. 2. Complex enterprise customization and advanced admin controls are necessary - For multi-entity reporting, strict governance requirements, or deep object customization, enterprise platforms with established partner ecosystems and customization capabilities (Salesforce, Dynamics) may be a better fit. 3. Predictable, contact-based marketing pricing at large scale is required - Organizations planning large marketing contact databases should model contact-based pricing and ask for incremental pricing clarity prior to commitment. 4. Support responsiveness and contractual SLAs for critical operations are required - Reviews indicate variability in support responsiveness; organizations requiring strict support SLAs should validate support terms contractually and conduct reference checks. 5. Outbound calling deliverability and number reputation are core to the business - Reported carrier/number reputation issues suggest pilots for target geographies and validation of outbound dialing practices before full roll-out.

- Marketing contacts limits on core plans (500 included) that typically require add-on purchases for larger databases.
- Add-on dependency for certain AI agent functionality and other advanced capabilities, which may increase total cost.
- Integration breadth: several independent reviews note fewer native third-party integrations than some competitors.

### Roadmap / signals

Independent reviews and press in early 2026 describe AI feature expansion (Freddy AI Copilot/agents and assistant-style functionality). Treat these reports as independent reviewer observations; verify specific SKU entitlements and tenant feature availability directly with the vendor.

title: Request to Increase API Rate Limit for KrispCall × Freshsales Integration - Product - Freshworks Developer Community
text:
# Request to Increase API Rate Limit for KrispCall × Freshsales Integration 

 Karun_Dixit (Karun Dixit) November 12, 2026, 1:30am 1 

Hi Freshworks Dev eloper Team,

I’m Karun Dixit, a Business Analyst at KrispCall ( https://krispcall.com ). We currently have an integration between KrispCall and Freshsales that enables users to manage business calls and SMS directly within their CRM workflows.

We would like to explore the possibility of increasing the API rate limit for our integration. Currently, the API rate limit is set to 1,000 requests, while the maximum available limit is 5,000 requests.

As our integration usage grows, the current limit may become restrictive for synchronization and other integration operations.

We would like to request an increase in the default API rate limit at the integration/backend level, so that the higher limit applies to all users of the KrispCall × Freshsales integration rather than requiring individual customers to request an increase.

Could you please let us know whether this is possible and guide us through the process? Thank you for your assistance.

title: Five popular customer tracking tools, and how to pick one for your business · Dashline
text:
A new buyer's guide from Small Business Trends compares five popular customer relationship management tools, known as CRMs. Its advice is simple: decide what you need and what you can spend before you look at any product. The five tools are Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive and Freshsales.

...

Pipedrive focuses on visual sales pipelines, meaning you can see deals move through stages. Freshsales uses AI to help manage leads. The guide suggests HubSpot and Zoho as good starting points for small firms, and says smaller companies may want to avoid the complexity of bigger platforms like Salesforce.

## What it costs

The guide gives price ranges per user, per month. Free options may work for people running a business alone.

- Entry-level plans: about $10 to $30
- Mid-tier plans: about $30 to $80, often with advanced tools such as AI
- Enterprise systems: about $80 to $300

Premium features may carry extra fees, so check the full price before you commit. The guide does not say what each of the five tools charges, so you will need to check with each company.
